projects.name: Aave
projects.desc: The largest decentralized lending and borrowing protocol. Deposit assets to earn yield or borrow against your holdings — all without intermediaries.
projects.thesis: Aave is DeFi's bank — except there's no bank. Permissionless lending at scale proves that financial infrastructure doesn't need gatekeepers.

projects.name: Bitcoin
projects.desc: The original decentralized currency — a peer-to-peer electronic cash system that requires no trusted third party. The bedrock of financial sovereignty.
projects.thesis: Bitcoin proved value can exist outside institutions, that trust can be mathematical, and that individuals can hold their own wealth without permission.

projects.name: Ethena
projects.desc: Synthetic dollar protocol generating yield through delta-neutral strategies. USDe offers a crypto-native stable asset backed by hedged positions, not banks.
projects.thesis: Ethena challenges the idea that stable value needs traditional banking rails. A yield-bearing dollar built entirely on-chain — DeFi-native stability.

projects.name: Ethereum
projects.desc: A decentralized platform for smart contracts and applications. Programmable money, DAOs, and the infrastructure for a new internet.
projects.thesis: Ethereum is the canvas where communities build their own rules, economies, and governance — without asking permission from anyone.

projects.name: Solana
projects.desc: High-performance blockchain built for speed and scale. Sub-second finality, low fees, and a thriving ecosystem of DeFi, NFTs, and consumer apps.
projects.thesis: Speed matters for adoption. Solana brings blockchain to the speed of thought — making decentralized apps feel as fast as centralized ones.

projects.name: Sui
projects.desc: Move-based Layer 1 blockchain designed for speed, low latency, and object-centric data. Built by former Meta engineers to make Web3 feel seamless.
projects.thesis: Sui's object model and parallel execution represent the next evolution of blockchain architecture — designed from scratch for mass adoption.

projects.name: Tether
projects.desc: The most widely used stablecoin — a digital dollar that bridges traditional finance and crypto. The liquidity backbone of decentralized markets worldwide.
projects.thesis: USDT is the de facto on-ramp and settlement layer for crypto. Its ubiquity across chains makes it critical infrastructure for the entire ecosystem.

projects.name: Virtuals Protocol
projects.desc: Platform for creating, co-owning, and monetizing AI agents. Tokenized AI characters that generate revenue across games, social, and entertainment.
projects.thesis: Virtuals is where AI meets collective ownership. Communities can co-create and profit from AI agents — decentralizing the value of artificial intelligence.

projects.name: Dogecoin
projects.desc: The original meme coin that became a cultural movement. What started as a joke became a symbol that communities can create value through shared belief.
projects.thesis: Dogecoin proves that value is a social construct. A community-driven asset that challenges traditional notions of what makes money real.

projects.name: Mantle
projects.desc: Ethereum L2 built by the BitDAO community. Modular rollup architecture with its own data availability layer, designed for lower fees and higher throughput.
projects.thesis: Mantle is an L2 backed by one of the largest DAO treasuries in crypto. Community-funded infrastructure scaling Ethereum for the next wave of users.

projects.name: Pendle
projects.desc: Yield trading protocol that tokenizes future yield. Split any yield-bearing asset into principal and yield components to trade separately.
projects.thesis: Pendle brings fixed income to DeFi. Yield markets are massive in TradFi — Pendle is building that infrastructure on-chain.

projects.name: Pepe
projects.desc: The frog-themed token that became the flagship of the meme coin movement on Ethereum. Pure community, no utility promises — just cultural consensus.
projects.thesis: PEPE is the purest expression of memetic value in crypto. It reminds us that culture, humor, and community are legitimate forms of consensus.

projects.name: Zcash
projects.desc: Privacy-preserving digital currency using zero-knowledge proofs. Financial transactions that are truly confidential — like cash, but digital.
projects.thesis: Privacy is not secrecy. Zcash embodies the belief that financial privacy is a fundamental right, not a privilege granted by institutions.

projects.name: Zora
projects.desc: A creator-first platform and L2 for minting and sharing media on-chain. Zora turns every piece of content into an on-chain asset anyone can collect.
projects.thesis: Zora reimagines social media as a creator economy where every post has value. Culture and content become ownable, tradeable assets.

projects.name: BNB
projects.desc: The utility token powering the BNB Chain ecosystem. High throughput, low fees, and the largest exchange ecosystem in crypto backing its adoption.
projects.thesis: BNB Chain brings millions of users on-chain. While more centralized than purist chains, its reach is undeniable for mainstream adoption.

projects.name: NEAR
projects.desc: A sharded Layer 1 blockchain with a focus on usability. Human-readable accounts, gas-free onboarding, and chain abstraction for seamless multi-chain UX.
projects.thesis: NEAR's thesis is that Web3 must be invisible. Chain abstraction and account aggregation put the user first — sovereignty without complexity.

projects.name: Toncoin
projects.desc: The blockchain integrated with Telegram. TON brings Web3 to 900M+ Telegram users through native wallets, mini-apps, and in-chat payments.
projects.thesis: TON has the most direct path to mass adoption of any L1. When crypto lives inside the chat app people already use, adoption becomes invisible.

projects.name: Cardano
projects.desc: Research-driven blockchain built on peer-reviewed academic papers. Haskell-based smart contracts with a focus on formal verification and governance.
projects.thesis: Cardano asks: what if we built a blockchain the way scientists build knowledge? Rigorous, peer-reviewed, and methodical — even if slower to ship.

projects.name: Worldcoin
projects.desc: A global identity and financial network using biometric proof-of-personhood to distinguish humans from AI online.
projects.thesis: As AI grows, proving you're human becomes essential. Worldcoin asks how we preserve human agency in an age of intelligent machines.

projects.name: XRP
projects.desc: A digital payment protocol designed for fast, low-cost cross-border transactions. Built for institutional settlement and global money movement.
projects.thesis: XRP focuses on the pipes of global finance. Whether you agree with its approach to decentralization, its institutional traction is undeniable.

projects.name: Internet Computer
projects.desc: A world computer running smart contracts at web speed. ICP hosts entire web applications on-chain — frontend, backend, and data — without cloud servers.
projects.thesis: ICP's vision is radical: replace the cloud entirely with a decentralized world computer. If it works, it's the most ambitious infrastructure play in crypto.

projects.name: TRON
projects.desc: High-throughput blockchain dominating stablecoin transfers. TRON processes more USDT volume than any other chain — the invisible backbone of crypto payments.
projects.thesis: TRON is crypto's unsexy workhorse. It may not win design awards, but its dominance in stablecoin transfers makes it impossible to ignore.

projects.name: ai16z
projects.desc: AI-managed venture DAO on Solana. Autonomous AI agents make investment decisions using on-chain data and social signals — decentralized venture capital.
projects.thesis: What happens when AI runs a VC fund on-chain? ai16z is the experiment — and it challenges every assumption about how capital should be allocated.

projects.name: Bio Protocol
projects.desc: Decentralized science protocol funding biotech research through tokenized IP. Communities pool capital to fund longevity, rare disease, and health research.
projects.thesis: Science funding is broken — slow, gatekept, and misaligned. Bio Protocol lets communities directly fund the research that matters to them.

USDC
projects.desc: Regulated dollar stablecoin by Circle. Full reserve transparency, regular attestations, and deep integration across DeFi and CeFi platforms.
projects.thesis: USDC bridges the compliance world and DeFi world. Fully backed, fully audited — the stablecoin that institutions trust.

projects.name: VitaDAO
projects.desc: DAO funding longevity research and owning IP in the aging science space. Community-governed biotech research for extending healthy human lifespan.
projects.thesis: VitaDAO applies crypto coordination to the most important problem: human health and longevity. Decentralized funding for the science of living longer.
